Sunday I had a break through watching the Royal Tenenbaums...of all things. Why haven't I put out an album in seven years? (Gwyneth Paltrow's character painfully reminded me of this).

I've been trying to do this album, called Open, for years. I've been paralyzed by it. Afraid of it, frankly.

So enough excuses. Thanks to Margot Tenenbaum, here's the first song from Open. This is the cleanest pella I've ever uploaded :)

Open will be a three part album - The Songs, The Remixes, The Production. There are 12 songs and I hope to record one a week (just pella, backing vox & piano). I'm writing this here because I know I won't do it unless I write it here. 

I can only hope and imagine this song will expand from here, with you all.

Inside Outside

I've almost given up
But it's love that keeps me here
Binding this Soul to skin
Inside

I've almost given up
But it's fate that ties me with
Golden ropes of faith
In a losing race
We fade
Away

Truth is something we can never see
It's intertwined with lies like you and me
Truth is something we can only be
Trapped behind these eyes are you and me

Inside, outside

Particles of you equaling me and all
Other matter, doesn't matter
How the curtain falls
Rust to dust, the stars or bust
I'm electronic light
Electronic light
Electronic light

Inside, outside

Wandering the galaxy with speed and sound
Whirling round I'm upside down
Just saying this aloud
Rust to dust, the stars or bust
I'm electronic light
Electronic light
Electronic light

Inside, outside 


key: d minor & b flat major (verse) f major (chorus).

bpm: 77 everywhere except the two bridges which are 100. 

am uploading mp3 and flac of all bvox, pella and piano.  recommend using xact to encode/decode flac to .wav or .aiff.  http://mac.brothersoft.com/xact.html

howididit.tools: I used Pro Tools to edit, import, track, treat, and mix. I played my Kurzweil 2500 for synth, strings, horns, and piano. Played a live harmonium track and all vocal tracks with my ATK mic. Tracked spinningmerkaba on my Zeta bass directly through the Digi-design 003 and his trumpet with the ATK. The rain track is actually from the first night I recorded the vocals - I opened up all the windows, turned up the gain to max, and did an entire song-length take of the rain.
howididit.samples: Imported Tanzmob's remix. Then cut it into several pieces, treating some sections with EQ. Cut and pasted various sections to create the 'song' format. I also incorporated a really cool rap from Tanzmob but I have no idea what he's saying. If anyone can translate, I'd love it!
howididit.origial: There are 10 vocal tracks on this song. The lead has 3 doubles. There are a couple of harmonies and a couple of counter-melodies in the last choruses as they build. I played harmonium, piano, strange little synth sounds, strings, horns as I mentioned above. I tracked spinningmerkaba on bass and trumpet. And recorded the rain personally :)
howididit.process: Lots and lots of cutting, pasting, aligning to the grid. This is the most detailed I've been about really aligning every part to the grid. Lots of zooming in, cutting the sample on both the front and the back of the 16th note bar, with a lot of fades on each little piece. Tanzmob's great remix was a perfect wireframe to build upon.
howididit.other: Creating this track was an emotional journey. Thanks for your support.

admiralbob77.review: Combining Peter Gabriel circa [i]Peter Gabriel IV[/i] with modern Hip Hop sensibilities, Snowflake does what CCMixter does best: celebrating life, and giving source tracks their own new and very different life.

upload_description_plain:
We had to send our sweet cat Charlie to heaven last week - he was only 10 months old and a very positive source of energy for our entire family. He was extra close to my heart and I've taken it pretty hard. I started working on my secret mixter track a day after he passed, and that night it was pouring rain in the dark night. I stood outside in the rain, just as this song describes, my tears blending with the raindrops. Suddenly I started dancing! Somehow it helped heal me, and this song was born.

Tanzmob's remix of illi was such an awesome frame for this song, and I cut, chopped, and copied. His excellent production, sounds and changes really inspired me in a new way. Although I have no idea what he's saying in the rap section, it felt right to include it :) 

spinningmerkaba played upright Zeta bass for me (channeling Tony Levin) and I cut, zoomed, pasted, aligned. I felt like I was channeling Peter Gabriel! he also played a great trumpet track that i manipulated.

I'll bounce pella and stems soon. Thanks for listening.

Dance in the Rain

Dance, dance, dance

I like to dance in the rain, head back, arms out
I like to dance in the rain, wash away my pain

Breaking down, make no sound

I'm gonna pray for the rain, give back this drought
I gotta dance in the rain, tonight that keeps me sane

To the ground, make no sound

And there's a whisper riding on the wind
Singing slow down, slow down
Staying here when the eye draws near
Saying slow down, slow down

Rain, rain, rain

Like to dance, I like to dance
Like to dance, I like to dance

I like to dance in the rain, clear off my doubt
I love to laugh in the rain, shed what I can live without

And there's a whisper riding on the wind
Singing slow down, slow down
Staying here when the Is draw near
Saying slow down, slow down

Breaking down, breaking down
To the ground, make no sound

Dance in the rain
Dance in the rain (repeat)

Breaking down, breaking down
Breaking down, make no sound

upload_description_plain:
Update: added a mix of just the vocal and guitar, without the phone messages :)

Spent the last several weeks with Jeff Grant's beautiful guitar playing. It's a strangely powerful connection, the one we gain with each other here at ccM -- through spending so much time with each other's personal creations. Thanks to all of you for giving me the courage to share some pretty personal things through music. 

It is my mom's 60th birthday! She is an incredible woman, mother and friend. I cried a large portion of the time while recording this ;)

The Heartstring

You gave me life
Soft like the moonlight
You take my wrongs helping me feel alright 

Your art of listening
Lifted by angel wings
You believe in me with all my world-saving crazy dreams

Your love wrapped around my soul
Where I'd be without you only God knows
Your heart is the truest part of me
Yea, you're the heartstring leading me home

Time's always changing
With memories we're saving
And your hope's behind me so I can endure anything

With each sweet, new chapter
Our children's laughter
Ties us all together always & forever

Your love wrapped around my soul
Where I'd be without you only God knows
Your heart is the truest part of me
Yea, you're the heartstring leading me home

We all know it's not been easy
With more than your fair share to carry
But you're still open and you keep on loving
When our world is storming
Your faith is transforming
And now I sing for you, for you
